svg.title: Follow-up Engine system design
svg.desc: System design of the Follow-up Engine: host EHR, API and ingestion, deterministic engine, agents and Meta AI, storage and runtime, deployment, validation, and seven technical-depth callouts.
svg.text: HL7 FHIR R4 in, signed webhooks out. Deterministic code decides; Meta Muse Spark reads and talks inside guardrails written in code.
Flag rule off for a patient
OpenAPI from the same zod schemas
clinic_id from the key, never the body
nothing of another clinic is visible
Versioned config · JSON validated by zod, never edited in place
config/rules: universal · doctor_plan · cadence · escalation (default_v1, default_v2)
config/protocols: diabetes, hypertension (ready for sign-off) + 5 drafts, opt-in
per-clinic override = new version (1.1.0+clinic.2), audited: who · when · old → new · why
orders, results, Rx, visits · no model
read once, at save time, via llm_gateway
replays each patient in a rolled-back txn, repairs diffs
one card per patient, every reason
sorted by priority, with its escalation step
Why? recomputes the due date from the
record and highlights the doctor's words
model read; a correction supersedes it
For the doctor: reviewer findings and
every model call goes through it
budget cap per clinic, per month
tokens, cost, latency logged per clinic
every call recorded: evals replay for $0
over budget → scripted / fallback, never stuck
Muse Spark tool calling · simulated WhatsApp
voice notes and result photos via the gateway
slots computed by code · booking only on an explicit yes
patient-message policy: no value, verdict, condition, test
≤ 2 proactive messages per patient per 7 days
opt-out stops all contact → FHIR Consent (deny)
engine-originated visits wait for the doctor
one bad quote drops the finding
live per category only with a
STORAGE & RUNTIME · hexagonal ports and adapters
VALIDATION · numbers as reported in the repository's docs
Muse Spark returns an interval ({amount, unit}) with a verbatim quote; code dates every
expectation, and “Why?” recomputes the due date from the stored record.
The agent cannot mark an order done
It writes FHIR Appointment / Observation through the same ingestion as POST /fhir; only
the engine's deterministic matching closes an expectation. The trace shows which.
No diagnosis can reach a patient
checkOutboundText refuses values, verdicts, condition and test names in every message;
a property test refuses 3,000 generated adversarial messages, every leak kind reported.
Every quote is checked word for word against the record; one bad citation drops the
whole finding. 0 of 348 extraction quotes and 0 of 43 reviewer citations invented.
Every case stores its rule version
Expectations and case reasons keep the rule and protocol version that made them
(1.1.0+clinic.2 after an audited override); old cases never change retroactively.
Idempotent end to end, repaired nightly
Outbox rows commit with the domain change; jobs lease with SKIP LOCKED; a re-sent Bundle
is harmless; a rolled-back nightly replay repairs only what a lost event left wrong.
Same code on Supabase or plain Postgres
Memory and Postgres adapters pass one contract suite; RLS is on for every table (a CI
test fails on a table without it) and clinic_id is part of every primary key.
